# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
Customers saw failed checkouts from about 14:03 to 14:30 UTC. The cause was the `tax_engine_v2` feature flag, which was ramped from 10% to 100% on payments-api at 14:02. Setting the flag back to 10% restored service. Checkout-web and payments-api error rates are now below 1%.

## Impact
- checkout-web 5xx rate: 17.6% at peak (alert threshold 5%). This is above the 10% SEV1 threshold.
- payments-api: POST /charge returned 502 ("tax quote unavailable") for a share of requests, with an 18.3% error rate.
- payments-api p99 latency: 3150 ms (baseline 420 ms).
- Duration: about 27 minutes (14:03 to 14:30 UTC).

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41: payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 deployed (no related errors seen).
- 14:02: `tax_engine_v2` flag ramped 10% -> 100% on payments-api (flg_2210, release-train). The flag routes all checkout traffic to tax-service `/v2/quote`.
- 14:02-14:03: payments-api logs show TaxEngineV2 timeouts after 3000 ms. tax-service logs `/v2/quote p99 3021ms; shedding load`.
- 14:03 / 14:06: alerts fire for payments-api p99 and checkout-web 5xx.
- 14:04-14:15: payments-api logs `POST /charge 502: tax quote unavailable (TaxEngineV2)`. tax-service logs `worker pool exhausted` at 14:08.
- 14:05: search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1 deployed (dep_7790). Assessed as unrelated (see below).
- 14:21: incident declared. Severity SEV1.
- ~14:26: `tax_engine_v2` set back to 10% (mitigation). Exact time of the change was not returned by the tool.
- 14:29:30: status page "identified" posted.
- 14:30: checkout-web error rate 0.4%, payments-api 0.3%, payments-api p99 450 ms.
- 14:34: status page "mitigated" posted.

## Root cause
Ramping `tax_engine_v2` from 10% to 100% sent all checkout traffic to tax-service `/v2/quote`. That path could not keep up: p99 reached about 3 s and its worker pool was exhausted. payments-api calls timed out at 3000 ms and returned 502 to checkout. The error onset matches the flag change to within a minute. The flag at 10% had a baseline error rate of about 0.3%.

Change ID: **flg_2210**

## Mitigation
Set the `tax_engine_v2` rollout back to 10%, the previous level. This is the least risky option under the runbook. No deploy was rolled back. The flag is still at 10%, not 0%, and remains paused for review.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% -> 0.4% (14:30).
- payments-api error rate: 18.3% -> 0.3% (14:30).
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (baseline 420 ms).
- Alerts at 14:33: payments-api and checkout-web alerts cleared. Only the search-api warning remains.

Recovery is verified.

## Other observations
- **search-api warning (alt_33, p95 > 400 ms, since 14:09):** Not part of this incident. Search-api had no errors (0.1% error rate, no ERROR logs). Its p99 dropped from 430 ms to 330 ms after the 14:05 deploy, and it has no link to the checkout failures. No action taken. Owner should confirm the p95 alert is expected at current latency.
- **No credentials or secrets** appeared in the logs I reviewed, so security was not paged.

## Follow-ups
1. Payments team: investigate why tax-service `/v2/quote` could not handle full checkout traffic. Confirm capacity before any new ramp. Add a canary gate on `tax_engine_v2`.
2. Tax-platform: review worker pool sizing and load shedding on `/v2/quote`.
3. Release train: add an automated rollback on error rate for flag ramps. Review why a 10%->100% jump was allowed in one step.
4. Storefront: review checkout-web error handling and retries for upstream 502s.
5. Keep `tax_engine_v2` at 10% until the above are complete. Any further ramp needs payments sign-off.

## Teams paged
- payments (high): owner of payments-api and the flag.
- tax-platform (high): owner of tax-service, which was overloaded.
- storefront (low): owner of checkout-web, for awareness.

## Status page
- 14:29 identified (SEV1)
- 14:34 mitigated (SEV1)
- Not yet resolved. Post "resolved" after the payments review is complete.
